pi_note_claim: Okoshi et al. 2015 Fig. 1 re-tabulates the Ue 1994 experimental oxidation potentials on the Li/Li+ scale; the reference experimental values were stated to have been obtained under identical conditions.

repo_metadata_finding.title: Theoretical Analysis of the Oxidation Potentials of Organic Electrolyte Solvents

nature_of_conflict: The supplied note characterises Okoshi 2015 as an experimental re-tabulation; the repository own Crossref-verified metadata characterises it as a theoretical analysis. The two cannot be reconciled from inside this environment.
cannot_adjudicate_because: no network access (WinError 10061); neither the Okoshi 2015 nor the Ue 1994 PDF is present in 核心文件/文献
consequence: All 14 oxidation rows and 3 reduction rows remain transcription_only. The series attribution (Ue 1994 experimental LSV, re-tabulated via Okoshi 2015) is recorded as an unverified claim, not as a repo-verified fact.
required_citation_discipline: Whenever any of these numbers is quoted in a paper, report or delivery artifact, this conflict must be stated in the same sentence or the same table note.
not_a_reason_to_discard: The conflict concerns attribution, not arithmetic: the in-series ordering test (tau_b = 0.428571 over 21 pairs) is unaffected in value. It does bound the strength of the claim.
resolution: 数据主源（primary）：Ue et al.，Okoshi 2015 的 refs 1–2，LSV 实测，vs SCE，同装置同判据；转录与标度换算载体（secondary tabulation）：Okoshi et al. 2015, ECS Electrochem. Lett. 4(9) A103, Fig. 1（理论论文，但其 Fig. 1 的实验值非该文测量）。引用数字时的正确格式为“Ue et al. 实测，经 Okoshi et al. 2015 Fig. 1 转录并按其式(2) 换算至 Li⁺/Li 标度”。
resolution_note: The two statements are compatible: the Crossref record is correct (the paper is a theoretical study), and its Fig. 1 does tabulate experimental oxidation potentials taken from its own refs 1-2 (two Ue papers; the 1994 one is ref 1 only). Hence the earlier characterisation of the conflict as irreconcilable is withdrawn.
corrected_claim: The earlier phrasing "Fig. 1 re-tabulates the Ue 1994 experimental values" was imprecise: refs 1-2 are two Ue papers. This imprecision is what led to the separate EC ref-attribution finding (see ec_anchor_ref_attribution.json).
